name: 5-EAPB
summary: Initially sold as a replacement to 5-MAPB, the drug seems to be less enjoyable than the former.

helpfulLinks.title: TripSit Factsheet
helpfulLinks.description: Rapid harm-reduction summary and combination data

pharmacology.text: 5-EAPB is similar in structure to compounds such as 5-APB which are claimed to be agonists of the 5-HT2C receptor as well as a triple monoamine reuptake inhibitor, however 5-EAPB is not listed as an example in this patent, and it is not yet established to what extent the activity of 5-EAPB resembles that of 5-APB.

uses.en: It has been sold online as a designer drug, originally as a replacement for 5-MAPB. It has no medical use.
uses.zh: 它曾在網路上作為設計師藥物販售，最初是5-MAPB的替代品，沒有醫療用途。
uses.zhHans: 它曾在网络上作为设计师药物贩售，最初是5-MAPB的替代品，没有医疗用途。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs that release serotonin strongly, such as MDMA, can cause jaw clenching, sweating, overheating, nausea, a racing heart and a low mood in the days after. Serious risks include dangerous overheating, low blood sodium from drinking too much water, and serotonin syndrome.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。強烈釋放血清素的藥物（例如MDMA）可能引起咬緊牙關、出汗、體溫過高、噁心、心跳急促，以及之後幾天的情緒低落。嚴重風險包括危險的體溫過高、因喝太多水造成的低血鈉，以及血清素症候群。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。强烈释放血清素的药物（例如MDMA）可能引起咬紧牙关、出汗、体温过高、恶心、心跳急促，以及之后几天的情绪低落。严重风险包括危险的体温过高、因喝太多水造成的低血钠，以及血清素症候群。

fact.en: Its benzofuran ring is MDMA's methylenedioxy ring reshaped: one oxygen is removed and the remaining one is built into a five-membered ring fused to the benzene ring.
fact.zh: 它的苯并呋喃環可以看成MDMA亞甲二氧基環的改造版：去掉一個氧，剩下的那個氧則組進一個與苯環相連的五元環中。
fact.zhHans: 它的苯并呋喃环可以看成MDMA亚甲二氧基环的改造版：去掉一个氧，剩下的那个氧则组进一个与苯环相连的五元环中。
